artifacts.finding: Reproducible 2026 SanGIS parcel snapshot; ARCC MPR/PAR attributes linked by exact APN.
Official outline geometry based on Spring 2017 imagery; current completeness and update cadence are unproven.
Repository manifest names a prior source, but has no source artifact, schema, importer, vintage, row count, or checksum.
Downstream view exposes assessor-style fields but cannot replace the upstream source receipt.
Legacy display divides assessor living area by parcel geometry area; it is not authoritative lot coverage.
Permit text and valuation do not establish present structures, size, units, or occupancy.
Bedrooms, baths, garage fields, effective-year codes, and use codes remain raw unless exact encoding/currentness is proven.
